purpose: A genuine thank-you card, calm and recognizably Homa without behaving like campaign collateral.

front.displayTypography: EB Garamond italic in the static art source, with a provider-safe fallback recorded before rasterization

providerReductionRules: Rasterize Homa-owned type and Logo geometry before upload; Handwrytten receives images, not web font files.
Keep all copy and Logo geometry inside the recorded trim-safe area; vendor quality checks are required for every cover.
Use only approved Quiet authority color tokens and their print-safe values; do not invent provider-only semantic colors.
Keep the front free of a Logo and promotional call to action; the back carries the master Homa lockup as a quiet maker mark.
Keep the writing side to the approved message and wishes exports; no child name, learning result, or inferred family detail is added.
